name: UE4SS Lua mod
summary: A Lua script mod for Unreal Engine 4 and 5 games that have UE4SS. No compiler: edit main.lua and restart the mods.
description: A UE4SS mod folder: Scripts\main.lua plus enabled.txt. The generated folder is the mod itself; it goes into the Mods folder next to UE4SS.dll. Pick the game and install.bat copies it to the right place.

options.label: Mod name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only
options.help: The mod folder is this name without spaces. UE4SS lists mods by folder name.

options.label: Author
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Game folder
options.help: The game's top folder. install.bat finds the UE4SS Mods folder under it. Leave empty to copy the mod by hand.

options.label: Key bind
options.help: RegisterKeyBind: run code when a key is pressed.

options.label: Key
options.patternHelp: a name from UE4SS's Key table, in capitals: F6, K, NUM_ONE, PAGE_UP
options.help: A name from UE4SS's Key table (listed at the bottom of Mods\Keybinds\Scripts\main.lua).

options.label: Console command
options.help: RegisterConsoleCommandHandler: a command typed into the game's own console.

options.label: Function hook
options.help: RegisterHook on an engine function: run code whenever the game calls it.

options.label: New object notification
options.help: NotifyOnNewObject: run code whenever the game creates an object of a class.

options.label: Safe object lookup helper
options.help: A FindFirstOf wrapper that returns nil instead of an invalid object.

options.label: Enable with enabled.txt
options.help: On: the mod folder carries an enabled.txt and loads without touching mods.txt. Off: install.bat adds the mod to mods.txt, which also fixes its load order.

next: Run install.bat: it copies the mod into the game's UE4SS Mods folder (set the game folder in game-path.txt first if it is empty).
Start the game and open UE4SS.log next to UE4SS.dll: look for "Starting Lua mod" with the mod's name, then its "loaded" line.
After an edit, run install.bat again, then press "Restart All Mods" in the UE4SS console window or restart the game.
